subject: Stratus Health — action list and adjusted target for implementation
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Mehra <rajiv@stratus.health>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: MAP draft + proposed milestones

Hi Rajiv,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier — it was helpful to understand Stratus Health's rollout priorities for Q1. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass action list (Stratus_MAP_v1.xlsx) to make the milestones and owners explicit. High-level proposal:

- Target pilot start: Jan 15, 2027 (pilot scope: 2 clinics, read-only inference, no PHI export)
- Security signoff & legal review: target by Dec 20 — dependency for pilot
- SSO / SAML test account: Stratus to provision by Dec 17
- Integration work (API + prefix caching): Redwood + Markus to estimate 3 dev-days

Can you confirm whether the dates above are reasonable? If any milestone needs to shift, share preferred dates and we’ll rework the timeline.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the attached MAP and mark any items that need to be moved or dropped (due: Dec 4)
2) We schedule a 30-min sync next week to finalize owners and the pilot acceptance criteria (I’ll send times)
3) Redwood will provide a test SSO checklist and a minimal SOW addendum for the pilot

Attachments: Stratus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SSO_Requirements.pdf (SSO checklist draft)

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

---
From: Rajiv Mehra <rajiv@stratus.health>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@stratus.health>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: MAP draft + proposed milestones

Camila — thanks for the draft. Quick update from our side after an internal prioritization session: we need to push the pilot window back to mid-February. Reasons:

- Security team just absorbed an unexpected FedRAMP readiness task; they cannot complete their checklist until mid-Jan.
- Our IAM (SAML) team is out for the holidays between Dec 20–Jan 5, which makes provisioning test accounts slower than expected.
- Clinical operations wants one additional data-mapping task completed before pilot to avoid rework.

Proposed adjusted targets (tentative):
- Security signoff: Jan 21, 2027
- SSO test accounts: Jan 18, 2027
- Pilot start: Feb 14, 2027

We still want to proceed and the priorities remain high — but the above dates are more realistic for us. Priya is looping in for the data-mapping checklist. I’ll try to get a finalized list of items for you by Dec 7.

Also, the security team asked that any PII/PHI handling be explicitly locked down in the MAP before we start the pilot; that may move some acceptance criteria.

Best,
Rajiv
VP, Digital Programs | Stratus Health
rajiv@stratus.health

Rajiv — thanks for the note and the context. Totally understood on the security and IAM timing. We’ll update the MAP to reflect the new tentative dates and tighten the acceptance criteria around PHI handling.

Immediate asks from Redwood:
- Priya — when you share the data-mapping checklist, please flag any items that must be completed before pilot vs. items we can handle during the pilot (due: Dec 7)
- Rajiv — can you confirm if an internal security review meeting is scheduled in mid-Jan? If so, we’d like to attend for any clarifying Q&A

I’ll reissue Stratus_MAP_v1 with revised dates and a short change log by Dec 4. If the security team requests additional artifacts (logs, retention policies), let us know and we’ll prioritize.

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Reprioritize MAP milestones & owners (Stratus)

Team — recap after Rajiv's reply: customer asked to move pilot from Jan 15 to Feb 14, security signoff now targeted for Jan 21 and SSO accounts around Jan 18. Impact on our work:

1) Integration estimate: Markus, please re-evaluate the 3 dev-day estimate assuming integration can begin Jan 22 (after SSO test accounts available). If there are blocking items that push work into Feb, flag them.

2) Acceptance criteria: Vanessa, update the pilot acceptance checklist to include explicit PHI/PII controls and retention settings. We should add a short section in the MAP under "Security & Data Controls" that spells out that no PHI leaves the environment and that audit logs are enabled during pilot.

3) SOW & contracting: I will hold the pilot SOW start date as Feb 14 pending final security signoff. If legal requests a redline, loop in Melissa from legal (I’ll intro if/when).

Action items and deadlines:
- Markus: revised dev estimate + any infra blockers (due: Dec 8)
- Vanessa: updated acceptance checklist + recommended MAP language (due: Dec 8)
- Camila: updated MAP v1 (dates + change log) and send final draft to Rajiv (due: Dec 4)

Attachments referenced: Stratus_MAP_v1.xlsx (will be replaced with v2 on Dec 4), SSO_Requirements.pdf

Thanks — we need tight turnaround so the account keeps momentum. I’ll push a 30-min slot on Rajiv’s calendar once v2 is out.

Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
